title: crataegus wattiana var. incisa
intro: Crataegus wattiana var. incisa, commonly known as Chinese hawthorn, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and reduce blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus wattiana var. incisa are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties, which may help to protect against cellular damage and improve cardiovascular function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenes, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
